name: waveform-vertical
title: Waveform (vertical)
description: Vertical: equalizer bars in a red to grey gradient pulse across the middle of the frame, like an audio visualizer. A WebGPU shader from the Shaders library (shaders.com, MIT); brand colours by default (dark ground, red and grey); every colour is a variable. Placement full, top or bottom card; fades in and out on cues.
